summary: Iter124 - Validated stale acting_org_id / X-Org-Id fix end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter124_stale_acting_org.py: 11/11 PASSED on https://manage-events-12.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified: (a) stale session_token cookie='garbage-expired' + valid access_token cookie -> /api/auth/me returns 200 (previously 401) - _get_base_user iterates tokens correctly; (b) non-member X-Org-Id still returns 403 on /api/events (authorization NOT relaxed); (c) QA + SA email/password login still 200; (d) SA without X-Org-Id -> 428 'Seleziona organizzazione', with valid org via platform listing -> 200; (e) Scenario A: Mongo-inserted TEST_ google user (auth_provider=google, google_sub, active, no membership) + minted HS256 JWT -> /auth/me 200, /events 403 (no org), stale X-Org-Id still 403. Playwright (desktop 1280x900): Scenario A - setting access_token cookie with JWT + localStorage.acting_org_id='stale_org_123' then navigating to /app -> correctly redirected to /completa-organizzazione (which requires Cellulare/phone mobile input as per spec), localStorage.acting_org_id cleared to null. Scenario B - QA login with pre-set stale acting_org_id='stale_org_abc' -> after /auth/login redirect to /app, localStorage.acting_org_id cleared (null), /app/eventi loads without events-loading infinite spinner and without events-load-error element, Dashboard has no [data-testid=todo-error], Staff/Volontari/Persone/Team pages render with no 'non consentito'/'non autorizzato' text. Code review verified: lib/googleAuth.js startGoogle() calls localStorage.removeItem('acting_org_id') before redirect; AuthContext.checkAuth clears stored id when user is not superadmin, not support, and id not in user.organizations; server.py _get_base_user tries session_token->access_token->Bearer in order with first-resolves semantics; /auth/login and google_login (_login + /oauth/google/link) both delete the old session_token cookie; Events.jsx renders [data-testid=events-load-error] with 'Riprova' ([data-testid=events-retry]) on settings===false instead of infinite 'Caricamento...'. All test data cleaned (0 TEST_ users, 0 TEST_ orgs remaining).

rca of the issue: Reproduced and fix confirmed. RCA: localStorage.acting_org_id persisted across logins/OAuth redirects. Password /auth/login path cleared it via AuthContext.logout (localStorage.removeItem) and set a fresh access_token cookie, but the Google OAuth redirect flow did not. Also, when a stale session_token cookie was present alongside a valid access_token, the old _get_base_user tried session_token first and raised 401 before even considering access_token. Fix verified: (1) googleAuth.startGoogle removes acting_org_id before window.location redirect; AuthContext.checkAuth removes it on load if user has no matching membership and is not SA/support; (2) _get_base_user now iterates all available tokens and returns the first that resolves, so a stale/expired session_token no longer shadows a valid access_token; (3) /auth/login + google_login endpoints both delete the stale session_token cookie after issuing a fresh access_token; (4) Events page replaces infinite 'Caricamento...' with [data-testid=events-load-error] + 'Riprova' button. Security invariant preserved: non-member X-Org-Id still returns 403.
